mapper.sql: id, user_id, bu_id, enabled, can_confirm, can_final_review, resource_qualifications, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into bu_member_profile (user_id, bu_id, can_confirm, can_final_review, resource_qualifications) values (#{userId}, #{buId}, coalesce(#{canConfirm},false), coalesce(#{canConfirm},false) and coalesce(#{canFinalReview},false), coalesce(#{qualifications},'')) on duplicate key update can_final_review = case when coalesce(#{canConfirm},can_confirm)=false then false else coalesce(#{canFinalReview},can_final_review) end, can_confirm = coalesce(#{canConfirm},can_confirm), resource_qualifications = coalesce(#{qualifications},resource_qualifications), updated_at = current_timestamp
insert into bu_member_profile (user_id,bu_id,enabled) values (#{userId},#{buId},#{enabled}) on duplicate key update enabled=values(enabled),updated_at=current_timestamp
